CustomField.description: The criterion this row is about, where the subject type is Decision_Criterion. Addendum 20: THE CRITERIA ANSWER'S SUBJECT IS THE CRITERION, one answer row per criterion, and the person stays on the row as OWNER rather than as key. Before this, a person naming three criteria produced one answer per contract, because the key was subject plus contract and the subject was the person - so two of the three vanished. Points at our own criterion ledger and not at ALTF__Decision_Criteria__c, because the system runs with Altify absent and claims land on our objects before anything is projected.
CustomField.label: Criterion
